verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official MCP server, with a dedicated docs page. It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables and redeploy, and one command configures it for detected tools. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and others via CLI or OAuth. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build with Railway using Agent Skills and the MCP server for AI-powered workflows.
